text.en:
Paragraph (c), subsection A of section one of Act Numbered Forty hundred and fifty-nine, is
hereby amended so that item one, on page live, under the caption "Bataan" shall read as follows:
"1. For the Orani Elementary School
4,000.00
"1-a. For the completion of the Daan-Pare, Orion Elementary School
1,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 27, 1933.
